_story: Headline bug-fix story. 3 consecutive outage hours, max_consecutive_dark=2. Mandatory load is 4 kW (2+2), and the only normal shop needs 2 kW to satisfy Rule 6. Mandatory+normal = 6 kW > 5 kW capacity, so the problem is provably infeasible: the normal shop must be on in at least one of the 3 outage hours, but there is no slack to do so. The buggy run-end counter missed this because it only fired at the end of the run. The fixed sliding-window constraint plus the post-solve infeasibility check catches it.
